speaker: Sam, infrastructure
title: Chips are failing in the {model} run
body: A batch of {chip} boards started crashing overnight. Training is limping along on the ones that still work.

choices.label: Replace the broken boards
choices.detail: Pay for replacements and lose a few days restarting.

choices.label: Run degraded
choices.detail: Keep going on fewer chips for the rest of the run.

choices.label: Stop and find the cause
choices.detail: Lose a week, but it won't happen again soon.

speaker: Priya, head of research
title: {model}'s training went off the rails
body: The model suddenly got worse at its lessons and hasn't bounced back. It might recover on its own. It might not.

choices.label: Go back to last week's saved progress
choices.detail: Safe. Costs about a week of progress.

choices.label: Push through
choices.detail: No time lost, but the model may come out worse.

choices.label: Slow down and learn carefully
choices.detail: Stable from here on, but slower.

speaker: Priya, head of research
title: {model} has seen the test answers
body: Some of our training data contains questions from the industry test. Our score would look great, and it would be a lie.

choices.label: Remove them and retrain that part
choices.detail: Clean, but costs two weeks.

choices.label: Filter and continue
choices.detail: Remove what we can. A small hit to quality.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.detail: Ship the inflated score. Someone may notice.

speaker: Jonas, product
title: {rival} ships {model}
body: {model} scores {score} on the smarts test. Reporters are asking what we think.

choices.label: Publish our results
choices.detail: Share our test scores and how we got them.

choices.label: Run a price promo for developers
choices.detail: Pull developers our way for a month.

choices.label: Stay heads-down
choices.detail: Let the next model talk.

speaker: Priya, head of research
title: A star researcher wants in
body: She can join next week, but wants a large signing bonus.

choices.label: Pay the bonus
choices.detail: One more researcher, and the community notices.

choices.label: Pass
choices.detail: Keep the cash.

speaker: Sam, infrastructure
title: API outage: 3 hours down
body: A bad deploy took the API offline. Developers are angry on social media.

choices.label: Refund customers and apologise
choices.detail: Pay back the people affected and explain what went wrong.

choices.label: Fix it quietly
choices.detail: Maybe nobody remembers by Friday.

speaker: Board chair
title: Investors want a growth story
body: Next week is the investor update. How bold should the forecast be?

choices.label: Promise big growth
choices.detail: Hype pulls users in, but misses get noticed.

choices.label: Stay conservative
choices.detail: Under-promise, over-deliver.

speaker: Grace, policy
title: The regulator wants to know how our model works
body: The AI office wants a report on our live model: what it learned from, how we tested it, and what could go wrong.

choices.label: Publish a full report
choices.detail: Costs time and legal review. Builds trust.

choices.label: Send the minimum
choices.detail: Technically compliant.

speaker: Jonas, product
title: Our model went viral
body: A demo of our model is everywhere this week. Sign-ups are spiking.

choices.label: Ride the wave
choices.detail: Spend on ads while attention is high.

choices.label: Let it play out
choices.detail: Free attention is still attention.

speaker: Kenji, factory manager
title: Dust got into {line}
body: Dust levels jumped in the clean room around {line}. The chips being made right now may be ruined.

choices.label: Scrap the batch and deep-clean
choices.detail: Lose two weeks of chips and $20M, but quality stays high.

choices.label: Keep the ones that pass testing
choices.detail: Keep running, but 30% fewer chips come out good for 6 weeks.

speaker: Kenji, factory manager
title: A key machine broke on {line}
body: The machine that prints chip patterns on {line} failed overnight. The maker can fly in a new one, at a price.

choices.label: Fly in a replacement
choices.detail: $40M and one week of downtime.

choices.label: Make do with the other machines
choices.detail: The line runs at half speed for 6 weeks.

speaker: Kenji, factory manager
title: Chip memory is running short
body: Our memory supplier is rationing everyone. Every production line that finishes chips will feel it.

choices.label: Pay spot prices
choices.detail: $60M to keep all the memory we ordered.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.detail: Only half the memory we need for 6 weeks.

speaker: A phone call
title: A big customer wants a rush job
body: A toy maker wants a custom version of our last chip by the holidays. They pay well, but it pulls us off our current project.

choices.label: Take the job
choices.detail: Good money now. Our current chip slips a month.

choices.label: Politely decline
choices.detail: Stay focused on our own chip.

speaker: The foundry
title: The foundry is running late
body: Our chip factory partner is behind schedule. Paying for a priority slot would keep us on track.

choices.label: Pay for a priority slot
choices.detail: Costs 5K, no delay.

choices.label: Wait our turn
choices.detail: The chip ships a month later.

speaker: A magazine editor
title: A magazine wants to profile us
body: Bytewise Monthly wants to write about the garage startup making chips. It would eat a week of our time.

choices.label: Do the interview
choices.detail: Customers get to know us. Small hit to the current chip.

choices.label: Keep our heads down
choices.detail: Back to work.

speaker: The trade show
title: A booth at the electronics show
body: There is one booth left at this year's big electronics show. It is not cheap.

choices.label: Book the booth
choices.detail: $20K. Customers and reviewers will notice us.

choices.label: Skip it this year
choices.detail: Save the money.

speaker: Late at night
title: A clever idea at 2 a.m.
body: A shortcut in the design could make this chip noticeably better, if it works.

choices.label: Try the new idea
choices.detail: Better chip, but it may cost a month.

choices.label: Stick to the plan
choices.detail: Ship on time.

speaker: Brightline Micro
title: A rival is courting our engineer
body: Brightline Micro offered one of our designers a big raise.

choices.label: Match the offer
choices.detail: $12K bonus, and the team feels valued.

choices.label: Wish them well
choices.detail: Morale dips and we may lose them.
